title: constant name inconsistency
symptom: The SlopeParameters constant "DEFAUL_HIGH_SLOPE_LOW" should be "DEFAULT_HIGH_SLOPE_LOW" in Calibration.java.
cause: The constant name has a typo: missing 'T' in 'DEFAULT'.
fix: The issue was resolved by renaming the constant to "DEFAULT_HIGH_SLOPE_LOW" in a commit.
evidence_quote: This should now be resolved in commit: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commit/6d170f24913eae811ff0074a98a0e7cbb7355c17
